parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have is_test=true and reside in the same test file, Shared/Playback/Tests/MP3StreamerTests/AudioEnginePlayerTests.swift. The two methods — AudioEnginePlayerTests.testPlay (line 115) and AudioEnginePlayerTests.testPlaySucceedsAfterEngineTearDown (line 365) — are distinct test cases that exercise different scenarios (a baseline play path vs. a recovery path after engine tear-down). Even though their structural similarity is high (Jaccard 0.83), the divergence in tested preconditions is intentional and necessary for correctness coverage; collapsing them would obscure the distinct failure modes each guards against.
